# definednet_tag (Data Source)

Looks up an existing tag by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "definednet_tag" "prod" {
  name = "env:prod"
}

output "prod_priority" {
  value = data.definednet_tag.prod.priority
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag in `key:value` form.

### Read-Only

- `config_overrides` (Attributes Set) Nebula config overrides applied to hosts with this tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_overrides))
- `description` (String) Tag description.
- `firewall_rules` (Attributes Set) Inbound firewall rules applied to hosts with this tag, in addition to their role's rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewall_rules))
- `id` (String) Same as `name`; tags have no separate ID.
- `priority` (Number) Precedence assigned by the API. Overrides from a higher priority win over lower ones.
- `route_subscriptions` (Set of String) Route IDs every host with this tag is subscribed to.

<a id="nestedatt--config_overrides"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config_overrides`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Dotted nebula config key, e.g. `lighthouse.dns.host`.
- `value` (String) JSON-encoded value for the key; use `jsondecode()` to read it.


<a id="nestedatt--firewall_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firewall_rules`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_role_id` (String) Only hosts with this role are allowed. Null allows every role.
- `allowed_tags` (Set of String) Only hosts carrying every one of these `key:value` tags are allowed. Null allows any tags.
- `description` (String) Optional description, at most 255 characters.
- `port_range` (Attributes) Inclusive port range. Null allows every port. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewall_rules--port_range))
- `protocol` (String) Allowed protocol: `ANY`, `TCP`, `UDP`, or `ICMP`.

<a id="nestedatt--firewall_rules--port_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firewall_rules.port_range`

Read-Only:

- `from` (Number) First port in the range (1-65535).
- `to` (Number) Last port in the range (1-65535), at least `from`.
